method: Costa Maya: the Mahahual reef (Chinchorrito to Punta Tam), the Parque Nacional Arrecifes de Xcalak down to the Belize border, and the Reserva de la Biosfera Banco Chinchorro offshore. Official lists: the CONANP programas de manejo for Xcalak (SIMEC 37_libro_pm.pdf) and Banco Chinchorro (SIMEC 53_libro_pm.pdf). Neither names dive sites beyond La Poza in Xcalak, so the official list counts only there; the Chinchorro programme confines scuba to a 'zona de buceo' on the atoll's west margin and allows only snorkelling in the 100 m 'zonas de pecios' around wrecks, so wrecks are excluded even though two operators sell them. Mahahual has no official site list. Operator lists, one each: Takata Experience, Pepe Dive Mahahual (its Mahahual, Xcalak, Chinchorro and FAQ pages are one operator), Mahahual Dive Centre, Amigos del Mar (Mahahual and Chinchorro pages, one operator; site names on the Chinchorro page are read from its image captions), Mar Adentro Diving, XTC Dive Center (Wayback copy of 2026; the live site returns 403) and Diving Xcalak. Takata's 'La Poza' (20-25 m, tarpon) is read as Xcalak's La Poza. Diving Mahahual (Diving Yucatan), Costa de Cocos and the XTC Chinchorro page name no sites; GLUUP, Divescover, Stingy Nomads, LocoGringo, ambergriscaye.com and the 2003 URI Mahahual report were read for leads only. A site is counted when named on two independent lists and divable on recreational scuba; one-list names and wrecks are excluded. XTC and Diving Xcalak print the same five Xcalak names; they are counted as separate operators. Counted 2026-10-14.
